parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, forming the front movable panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior of the cabinet by opening and closing, providing a barrier to protect stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame, allowing it to swing open and closed.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet frame made of wood, forming the main structural body of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet, holding the door, base, and shelves in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet base made of wood, forming the bottom support structure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the entire cabinet, distributing weight evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is a wooden shelf located inside the cabinet, used for organizing stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and separates stored items within the cabinet, increasing storage efficiency.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
